shortDescription: The outlook on the bank's Baa1 senior unsecured debt rating was changed to stable from negative. Limassol, September 21, 2026-- Moody's Ratings has today affirmed Eurobank S.A.' s long-term deposit and senior unsecured ratings at Baa1, and its Baseline Credit Assessment and Adjusted BCA at baa3.
